description: An unreached restored query does not exclude ordinary finite recursive proofs (engine §4 and §10).
grammar:
%rule text $x:X %conditions Recursive ⊆ $x.tags(q)

%rule q $y:r %conditions ($.source-text = "x" ∨ $y.without-elision.matches(rival))

%rule r (r [+U]) :: Recursive | X :: ∅
%rule rival X
